title: Efficient Estimation of Word Representations in Vector Space
summary: Tomas Mikolov, Kai Chen, Greg Corrado, and Jeffrey Dean submitted "Efficient Estimation of Word Representations in Vector Space" to arXiv on January 16, 2013. The paper proposes two model architectures for computing continuous vector representations of words from very large data sets.
significance: A documented 2013 natural-language-processing research milestone for efficient continuous word representations, recorded as a paper-submission milestone rather than a software or toolkit release.

verification.note: The original arXiv record establishes the January 16, 2013 first-submission date, authors, and the paper's two-model contribution. Google Research independently identifies the work as an ICLR 2013 publication and describes the same contribution. LINEAiGE records only the paper-submission research milestone and does not infer a word2vec toolkit release date, geography, ancestry, influence, causality, or relationships.
